goal: Automatically remove the obsolete coinstats index directory on startup to reclaim wasted disk space
Relieves upgraded node operators from having to locate and delete the legacy directory manually
agreement: Clarified that deleting the obsolete index before creating the new one is safe (bartoli)

categories.name: indexes
why: P3 because it is routine cleanup reclaiming disk space on nodes upgraded from older releases
The space savings only help nodes that built the index on v29 or earlier and upgraded
